_doc: Le Quartier phase 1: one T1 day A journey through the real API (test server, fake model: the classifier routes the French below; no model ack lines, so no <turn>.ack beats appear). An A2 learner reading English. Each attempt's AttemptResult.journey is elided after the first full snapshot.

calls.note: The day is created. The scene step's prompt.stage is the page as the 3D stages it.

scenario.objective_native: Say who you are and why you are here.

prompt.setup_fr: Paris. Le 11 novembre. Il pleut. Tu as une valise, une lettre et une clé.
prompt.setup_native: Paris. 11 November. It's raining. You have a suitcase, a letter and a key.
prompt.objective_native: Say who you are and why you are here.

stage.can_do_native: Say who you are and why you have come; correct a misunderstanding.

movements.visual: Night rain on the quai de Valmy. The red neon MISTRAL on the corner. Toi from behind, with a suitcase and an envelope held under the coat against the rain. Through the café's window, Gus stands on the booth's bench mid-anecdote, and Marin and Lila look up at him. Far background, rue de Lancry: a third-floor window, an old man at an easel, tiny, never lit brighter than the street.

lines.text_fr: Paris. Le 11 novembre. Il pleut. Tu as une valise, une lettre et une clé.
lines.text_native: Paris. 11 November. It's raining. You have a suitcase, a letter and a key.

movements.visual: Inside Le Mistral. The door's bell. Heads turn. Gus is still standing on the bench, one hand raised, and freezes mid-story. Marin holds a spoon of soup halfway to his mouth. Lila, chin on her fist, is already interested.

lines.name: Gus
lines.text_fr: …Et le duc me dit : "Augustin, vous êtes trop élégant pour ce siècle."
lines.text_native: …And the duke says to me: "Augustin, you are too elegant for this century."

movements.visual: The zinc, close. Toi's hand sets down the envelope, and on top of it the key ring: an old key and a small enamel cicada, green and gold. Margaux's hand, drying a glass, stops. We see only her hand and the cicada.
Gus steps down from the bench and crosses the room with a bow that is too deep. The group watches behind him.

lines.name: Gus
lines.text_fr: Ah ! Vous voilà. La personne de M. Marchand, je suppose ? On vous attend.
lines.text_native: Ah! There you are. M. Marchand's person, I suppose? We've been waiting for you.

movements.visual: Marin stands and politely pulls out a chair for Toi, then cannot help himself. Behind him, Lila looks down at Toi's feet.

lines.name: Marin
lines.text_fr: Vous allez vraiment vendre l'appartement d'Odile ? À Solvel ?
lines.text_native: Are you really going to sell Odile's flat? To Solvel?

lines.name: Lila
lines.text_fr: Regarde ses chaussures, Marin. Ce n'est pas Solvel, ça.
lines.text_native: Look at the shoes, Marin. That's not Solvel.

movements.task_native: Say who you are and why you are here.

panel.visual: Gus leans on the zinc beside Toi in his three-piece suit, all charm and no warmth. Toi's balloon, empty, is drawn from behind Toi's shoulder.

movements.task_native: Take the café crème Margaux set down for you, or say no.

panel.visual: The café crème steams on the zinc in front of Toi. Margaux waits, a cloth over her shoulder. From the booth, Marin watches the cup as if it might say something.

lines.name: Margaux
lines.text_fr: Le café crème est pour toi. Tu le prends ?
lines.text_native: The café crème is for you. Will you take it?

movements.task_native: Tell Margaux whether you will go up to the flat tonight, and what you plan to do.

panel.visual: Margaux picks up the key ring and turns the cicada in her fingers. Marin and Lila lean in from the booth. Gus pretends not to.

lines.name: Margaux
lines.text_fr: Elle ne donnait jamais cette clé.
lines.text_native: She never gave that key to anyone.

movements.task_native: Take the key, or leave it with Margaux for the night.

panel.visual: The key ring lies on the zinc between Toi and Margaux, the cicada up under the neon. Margaux's hand rests beside it, not on it.

lines.name: Margaux
lines.text_fr: La clé : tu la prends, ou tu la laisses ici ?
lines.text_native: The key: will you take it, or leave it here?

panel.visual: The bell again. In the doorway stands a figure in a rain-soaked bike helmet, holding up a key: Camille, seen from the side, not yet in close-up. On the zinc in the foreground lies Toi's key with its cicada. Two keys in one frame. Gus looks from one to the other.

lines.name: Camille
lines.text_fr: Bonsoir. Camille Marchand. Je viens pour le premier étage. J'ai la clé.
lines.text_native: Good evening. Camille Marchand. I'm here about the first floor. I have the key.

lines.text_fr: Deux clés pour la même porte. À suivre…
lines.text_native: Two keys for the same door. To be continued…

lines.name: Gus
lines.text_fr: Bon. Où en étais-je ? Ah oui. Le duc.
lines.text_native: Right. Where was I? Ah yes. The duke.

lines.text_fr: C'est Margaux. Ta valise est toujours là.
lines.text_native: It's Margaux. Your suitcase is still here.

prompt.objective_native: Say who you are and why you are here.

cast_intro.name: Margaux
cast_intro.role_native: Runs Le Mistral. Says very little, sees everything.

cast_intro.name: Gus
cast_intro.role_native: A regular. Theatrical, always in the middle of a story.

cast_intro.name: Marin
cast_intro.role_native: A regular. Kind, sentimental, feeds everyone.

cast_intro.name: Lila
cast_intro.role_native: A teacher and painter. Quick, and hard to impress.

cast_intro.name: Camille
cast_intro.role_native: Arrives at the end of the first evening, with a key to the first floor.

response.story_premise_native: You are in Paris for one week. Your grandmother Odile has left you a small flat above a café, Le Mistral. You have come to sign the papers and to sell it. Tonight, in the rain, you walk into the café with her key. The regulars knew her. They do not know you yet.
response.story_how_native: Read each scene, then answer the person speaking to you, in French and in your own words. Mistakes are fine: they react to what you mean.

calls.note: The learner walks out during Gus's story (a.p2) and comes back: the answer is the line said on their return.
